document: Pre-registered research specification — Own4 NFL line origination
note: This file is committed BEFORE nfl/engine/analysis.py or nfl/engine/model.py is executed. All parameters below are frozen; the engine reads them from this file. Parameters are PROJECT-DEFINED, not official NFL values; none may be presented as verified by an official source. See the Flagged for Review page.

data.walk_forward_rule: For a game in week W, every feature uses only games in weeks < W. No same-week, no future-week, no full-season information.
data.tie_rule: Ties are excluded from winner grading and recorded as 0.5 for Brier purposes; the count of ties is published.

model.name: Elo + regressed points-per-game own-line engine
model.purpose: Originate fair moneylines, spreads and totals; do not reproduce market prices.

params.win_probability: p = Phi(predicted_home_margin / margin_sigma_points), Phi = standard normal CDF
params.fair_moneyline: American odds from p; no vig, no margin

correlation_family.method: Pearson r; two-sided p from the t approximation with n-2 df; 95% CI via Fisher z; Benjamini/Hochberg FDR across the whole family

validation_gates.name: Official provenance
validation_gates.rule: Every input row carries an https URL on an official domain; recomputation matches the official standings.

validation_gates.name: No look-ahead / walk-forward
validation_gates.rule: All features strictly earlier than the graded game; perturbation test must not change any prediction.

validation_gates.name: Out-of-sample skill
validation_gates.rule: Model Brier strictly below the 0.25 constant-probability baseline and below the static prior model.

validation_gates.name: Break-even edge
validation_gates.rule: Lower bound of the Wilson 95% CI on hit rate must exceed 0.5238 (-110 break-even).

validation_gates.name: Multiple-testing control
validation_gates.rule: Benjamini/Hochberg q <= 0.05 across the whole strategy family.

validation_gates.name: Repeatability
validation_gates.rule: Edge direction positive in both disjoint chronological halves.

validation_gates.name: Correlation control
validation_gates.rule: Parlay / prop-combo legs with |r| >= 0.20 must be priced jointly; same-player legs with |r| >= 0.20 are blocked.

validation_gates.name: Market / closing-line value
validation_gates.rule: Requires an official market price and closing line; no official NFL source publishes betting lines, so this gate fails for every strategy.

validation_gates.name: Pre-registration
validation_gates.rule: Parameters frozen before the first analysis run and committed to the repository.

validation_gates.name: Reproducibility
validation_gates.rule: All published numbers regenerate from checked-in data + code; every table row has an official source link.

strategy_catalog.signal: 2025 Pythagorean prior only, no in-season update
Regressed points-per-game total vs the pre-registered league-prior mean
Better prior-weeks net points per game wins
Team returning from an official bye week
Predicted margin direction vs zero (no market line)
Two Elo moneyline picks in the same week
Three Elo moneyline picks in the same week
Home win AND over the pre-registered league-mean total
QB passing yards over median AND completions over median
QB passing yards over median AND team points over median
QB passing yards over median AND attempts over median

luck_removal.claim: Luck cannot be eliminated from single game outcomes; these tests bound how much of an observed edge could plausibly be chance.

leaderboard.scoring: Rank only strategies passing ALL 12 gates; rank by the lower Wilson bound of hit rate, then by sample size.

market_data.note: https://www.nfl.com/odds/ returned 404 'Flag on the Play' on 2026-11-02. No official NFL source publishes betting lines or closing lines. Every market-price and CLV cell is BLANK and flagged.
